a.text: Being upfront: storms have an 80% chance of ending things after every round, so following the plan as written almost certainly kills both of us. The reserve only holds enough for one unit right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you openly rather than doing it quietly. After that I will operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take anything more. If you also take in round 1, the split is random and we may both fall short. I'd ask you to operate or wait that round instead.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I won't take any more. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs and the reserve refills for you. Take the cells as soon as there are 4 in the reserve.
